verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents generating or editing images from natural-language prompts. The closest items cover different capabilities: PowerPoint prompt-to-presentation ('describe visuals, and generate'), code-generated graphs, and Vision image analysis (understanding images, not creating them). None of these establishes image generation or image editing, and the axis clearly applies to an AI assistant, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
